title: Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO Details
intro:
Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is a book build issue of ₹35.93 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 50.61 lakh shares of ₹35.93 crore.

Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO opens for subscription on Sep 28, 2026 and closes on Sep 30, 2026. The allotment for the Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 1, 2026. Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 6, 2026.

Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO is set issue price band at ₹65 to ₹71 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,27,200 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,40,800.

Expert Global Consultants Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is JSK Securities & Services Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in November 2016, Acme Universal Safezone 9 Limited operates in the Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) segment, focusing on industrial safety footwear for sectors including construction, oil and gas, mining, heavy engineering, automotive, pharmaceuticals, chemical processing, foundry and power generation. It offers 15 product lines across EVA-rubber, Nitrile Rubber and PVC sole types, providing protection against impact, compression, penetration, electrical shock, static electricity, heat and fire, chemicals and slipping.

The Company operates four manufacturing facilities across Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. It uses ICad3D technology for product design and visualisation and SAP S/4 HANA for enterprise resource planning across finance, operations and logistics. Its products are distributed through direct institutional sales, regional distributors and dealers, and digital and e-commerce channels, supported by warehousing at more than 40 locations across India. The Company also exports to markets including the UAE, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, Israel, the Netherlands, Hong Kong, Cameroon and Mauritius.

The Company manufactures products compliant with applicable IS 15298, EN ISO 20345, ASTM F2413 and SEDEX SMETA standards, depending on the product variant and export destination. It also develops customised products based on customer requirements. For FY2026, the Company reported revenue from operations of ₹20,590.31 lakhs, EBITDA of ₹1,515.19 lakhs and PAT of ₹585.73 lakhs.
As of March 31, 2026, the Company had a total manpower strength of 1,073 employees across finance, HR, IT, marketing, operations and sales.

faqs.question: How to apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Acme Universal Safezone 9 IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.
